Maia Docs

Maia is the AI Data Automation platform by Matillion.

Level up your product knowledge with our how-to guides, reference material, API docs, and tutorials.

![](https://mintcdn.com/matillion/0xM0A92Owv1nZXX1/images/maia-favicon-dark-green.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=0xM0A92Owv1nZXX1&q=85&s=356295fc83c5c6d1ed4aac2573ae45b1)

## Build with Maia

Use natural language to build, configure, and run data pipelines with your agentic AI data team.

[**Build pipelines** \\
\\
Describe your data objective and Maia builds the pipeline—orchestration, transformation, and execution, all from the chat panel.](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/guides/maia-pipelines)

[**Use SKILL.MD files** \\
\\
Create reusable instruction sets that Maia activates when relevant, so you define your standards once and apply them everywhere.](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/guides/maia-skills)

[**Define rules in context files** \\
\\
Embed business rules, naming conventions, and project context so every Maia interaction applies your standards automatically.](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/guides/maia-context-files)

[**Create custom connectors** \\
\\
Point Maia at any API documentation page and it generates a working custom connector, handling authentication automatically.](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/guides/create-a-custom-connector-with-maia)

## Connectors

Load data from your most important sources directly into your cloud data platform.

[**Salesforce** \\
\\
Load Salesforce data into Snowflake—tables created and managed automatically.](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/components/salesforce-load)

[**Kafka** \\
\\
Stream data from Kafka topics into Snowflake, Databricks, or Amazon Redshift as JSON or schema objects.](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/components/kafka)

[**Anaplan** \\
\\
Query the Anaplan Bulk API and land your export data into your preferred cloud data platform.](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/components/anaplan)

[**Workday** \\
\\
Load HR and workforce data from Workday into Snowflake, with full and incremental loading support.](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/components/workday-load)

## Transformation components

Shape, clean, and prepare your data with drag-and-drop transformation components.

[**Aggregate** \\
\\
Group and summarize rows into a single output—totals, averages, min/max—without writing SQL.](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/components/aggregate)

[**Calculator** \\
\\
Add calculated columns using expressions, from simple arithmetic to complex business logic.](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/components/calculator)

[**Detect Changes** \\
\\
Compare two datasets and tag each row as inserted, deleted, changed, or unchanged.](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/components/detect-changes)

[**Pivot** \\
\\
Turn rows into columns to restructure and aggregate your data across categories—equivalent to SQL PIVOT.](https://docs.maia.ai/docs/components/pivot)

## API

Automate and integrate with Maia programmatically using the REST API.

[**Create a new project** \\
\\
Provision a complete, functional project using modular API endpoints—no manual setup required.](https://docs.maia.ai/api-reference/projects/create-a-new-project)

[**Create a schedule** \\
\\
Automate pipeline execution by scheduling artifacts with flexible version targeting.](https://docs.maia.ai/api-reference/schedules/create-a-new-schedule)

[**Execute a published pipeline** \\
\\
Execute, monitor, and terminate published pipelines via the API.](https://docs.maia.ai/api-reference/pipeline-execution/execute-published-pipeline)

[**Review pipeline quality** \\
\\
Programmatically validate pipelines against your configured quality rules.](https://docs.maia.ai/api-reference/pipeline-quality-review/review-pipeline-quality)
